about: Profile info shown by tools/frigate_search_705.py (--help, start banner, --list-profiles). Edit the numbers here after re-measuring; the tool reads this file at start. 'presets' is the stage-A preset set the tool really uses.
caveat: Recall comes from limited samples: the 160,663 systems in the scanner DB with Salvaged Frigate Modules computed (galaxy 0 regions around the scanned area) and one test region (0460ACAA: 81 systems with >=2, 18 with >=3, only 1 with >=4 modules). Other regions can differ by 10-20 points (05605CAA had 65% >=3 recall for balanced vs 81% atlas-wide). Speeds are single runs on this 12-thread PC (scanner reference = mean of 2 runs); the live scanner was scanning on and off during the runs (host CPU 34-85%), so treat them as +-15%. 'Cached writer' speeds apply only when the writer results are already in the writer cache (re-search of systems the scanner, a backlog or an earlier search generated).

no-filter.summary: baseline: every system fully computed, nothing missed (same work per system as the scanner)

all.summary: all 10 presets, stage B only: skips the post-writer work for systems with too few containers

balanced.summary: default: the 4 CARGO presets FLOATERS/TURRETS/MAZE/BUGS (no SLIME, no MEDI_*) + stage B

fast.summary: balanced without the slow CARGO_TURRETS preset: CARGO FLOATERS/MAZE/BUGS + stage B
